name: Husserl-1
source:
In a remote settlement of only 1,000 people on an icy planet where nothing can grow, two Cosmiczon Ltd. employees complete the last delivery on their list. They might soon come to understand that the real reason they are there might endanger their lives.

[From [url=https://unapersona-y-otrapersona.itch.io/husserl-1]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在一个只有1,000人的偏远定居点，在一个冰冷的星球上，没有任何东西可以生长，两名Cosmiczon Ltd. 员工完成了他们清单上的最后一次送货。他们可能很快就会明白，他们在那里的真正原因可能会危及他们的生命。

[来自[url=https://unapersona-y-otrapersona.itch.io/husserl-1]Itch.io[/url]]
